operation: Existing Show editor on the v2 backing at 1440x900 with reduced motion, a fresh Installation Show seeded through /api/shows with its boundary Transition removed and stored as v2: two adjacent Clips on one Layer and no Transition (TestPattern1D 0-30 s, CometLoom 30-60 s, layer:zone-1:main). TestPattern1D is selected and 45 is typed into the Clip inspector's Duration field; that would cover CometLoom, so the clip-temporal owner refuses the overlap. The Entity Detail Panel shows one role=alert line, its last element, reading 'Clips on one Layer cannot overlap.', and the Duration field is restored to 30. 1.5 s later the stored v2 record is unchanged: updatedAt 1790222227073 before and after, and both Clips keep the same start, duration and Layer (0/30000 and 30000/30000 on layer:zone-1:main). The capture shows the panel with the alert line and the restored field.
